column1: # Breaking changes to the CONSUMER SURFACE, and where each is announced.
# One row per commit that (a) carries the conventional-commit `!` marker and
# (b) touches lib/. tool/check_breaking_recorded.sh enforces the mapping in both
# directions: no such commit may be missing a row, and no row may name an
# anchor that has fallen out of CHANGELOG.md.
# The anchor is a distinctive phrase that must appear VERBATIM in CHANGELOG.md.
# It is deliberately a phrase and not a heading: headings get reworded, and a
# check that only survives careful editing is not a check.
# WHY: `43366ba fix(limits)!` shipped with no CHANGELOG entry and no ledger row,
# including the part where web went from silently ignoring `limits:` to throwing
# UnsupportedError. The prose cross-check that should have caught it ("19 rows,
# 19 in the CHANGELOG") had been run, and went stale within a day.
# Format: <short-sha>\t<anchor phrase that must appear in CHANGELOG.md>
